cards.title: Curated Reading List: Open-Source AI & Open Models (Updated Sep 2026)
cards.why_it_matters: As an AI/research engineer, this is a single-stop reference covering the technical, economic, safety, and geopolitical dimensions of open-weight models — directly relevant to understanding where the field is heading and how to position research work.
cards.summary: Nathan Lambert's continuously updated reading list covers open-model strategy, licensing gradients, safety tradeoffs, data commons decline, US-China competition, and adoption data. Key anchors include Solaiman's release-gradient framework, Bommasani et al. on societal impact, Longpre et al. on data consent crises, and Thinking Machines Lab's safe open-weights position paper.
